name: Cart
description: The shopper's cart as a slide-in drawer or a full page: editable line items, a free-shipping progress note, discount codes, totals and checkout.

fields.name: Variant
fields.helpText: drawer opens from the header bag; page is the full cart page.

fields.name: Free shipping threshold
fields.helpText: Major units, e.g. 80.00. Empty hides the shipping bar. Must match the backend rules.

fields.name: Note
fields.helpText: Sits under the totals, e.g. what checkout still adds.

fields.name: Empty title
fields.helpText: Shown with a shopping-bag icon when the cart has no items.

fields.name: Empty text
fields.helpText: One or two sentences with the next step.

fields.name: Empty link label
fields.helpText: The empty state's primary button, e.g. Continue shopping.

fields.name: Empty link
fields.helpText: Where the empty state's button goes, e.g. /collections/all.
